description: Election Commission - V. Somasuntharam was elected as the member of the Chavakachcheri P/S - A. Nadarasa was elected as the member of the Chavakachcheri P/S
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in a local government body (Chavakachcheri Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local government positions, including declarations of elected members to fill vacancies caused by resignations. This falls directly under election-related matters, specifically covering candidate nominations and declarations of election results for local government positions.
